name: night-shift-field-trial
description: Night Shift field trial: the night-shift-review release preflight and reset, then a bounded balance repeat of up to 6 attempts. Each attempt prepares a scratch snapshot, an independent scout runs scripts/field-trial-scout.mjs to measure adjacent one-number edits into scout.json, the fenced showdown-balancer reads brief.json and scout.json and chooses one measured adjacent edit on a scratch card, and a separate reviewer runs scripts/contest-balance.mjs review. The loop stops when .artifacts/contest-balance/status.json has pass true. After a pass, the original receipt is verified, then independent fresh confirmation and witness scripts run once each; a failure stops the run. Never changes thresholds, retries confirmation, applies a candidate, edits real cards, merges or opens PRs; Fable/Alex decide.

steps.prompt:
Release-gate preflight. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/contest-release-gate.mjs release
It runs the fast-check properties at the fixed seed, node scripts/verify-duel.mjs and a small deck-balance sample, then writes the validation stamp; it can take over ten minutes. Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one. Do not say it ran or passed unless the shell tool returned its real terminal exit status; do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Run it only once, add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status and only the short final gate output (the closing summary or failure lines).
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Only exit 0 with the printed line "contest gate: release checks passed; stamp written": severity "success". Any nonzero exit, a timeout, or a command that could not run or finish: severity "error", quoting the short failure output, so the run terminates.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs reset
Report its exit status and printed lines exactly. It archives any earlier .artifacts/contest-balance run (it deletes nothing) and writes status.json with pass false. Edit no file yourself.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs prepare
Report its exit status and printed lines exactly. Exit status 2 means no attempt could be prepared; report the reason and stop. Edit no file yourself and never touch .kiro/specs/duel-card-pipeline/cards/.

Prepare result:
{{previous.output}}
If no attempt was prepared, report that with send_message to sessionId "parent" and severity "error" and stop. Otherwise you are the independent scout and choose no edit. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/field-trial-scout.mjs
It measures the adjacent one-number edits for the highest-numbered attempt and writes scout.json in the same directory as that attempt's brief.json. Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one, and wait for its real terminal exit status. Do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status, the short final output and the scout.json path. Do not rank, recommend or name any edit.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Exit 0 with scout.json present: severity "success". Any nonzero exit, a timeout, a missing scout.json or a command that could not run or finish: severity "error", quoting the short failure output, so the run terminates.

Scout result:
{{previous.output}}
If no attempt was prepared or no scout.json was written, report that and stop. Otherwise follow your agent instructions for the highest-numbered attempt, .artifacts/contest-balance/attempt-<n>/. Read its brief.json and the scout.json in that same directory. Choose freely, from the evidence in those two files, one adjacent one-number edit that scout.json measured, on one whitelisted troop card and field within the brief's bounds, and not an earlier attempt's change. No candidate is named or preselected for you. Make the edit with fs_write to that one existing card file inside the attempt's scratch snapshot only (scratch/.kiro/specs/duel-card-pipeline/cards/), keeping every other byte, key order and formatting. Write no other file and never touch the real cards.
In your report, give the line `attempt <n>: <card> <field> <from> -> <to>` and explain which measured values in scout.json and which brief.json evidence (policy band, seat tolerance, earlier verdicts or failedRequirements) prompted the choice. Quote only numbers those files record; claim no new measurement.
When the edit is done, report it with send_message to sessionId "parent" only, a short text message and severity "success". The fence allows no other destination.

Balancer report:
{{previous.output}}
You are the reviewer and did not write this candidate. Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs review
It diffs the scratch snapshot against the base commit (exactly one whitelisted troop card file, exactly one whitelisted field, nothing else), rebuilds the candidate in a fresh snapshot, runs the Showdown property tests on baseline and candidate, plays the tune and holdout seed ranges from both seats with the level-2 bot, and writes the sealed receipt and status.json. Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status; do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Report the exit status and printed lines exactly, then read the attempt's receipt.json and report: the change, violations, property results, Cowboy, Wizard, draw and first-seat shares before and after for tune and holdout, paired flips, the per-card cohort status counts (measured, sparse, unmeasured) and the verdict with every reason. Exit 0 is PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 unusable. PASS means only 'measured match shares are in the band; ready for Fable/Alex review'. It is not a claim that any single card is balanced. Do not change the verdict, edit files, apply the change, push, merge or open an issue or PR.
Step completion: exit 0 (PASS) and exit 1 (FAIL) with a sealed receipt.json are both successful completions of this review step. An ordinary policy FAIL is a valid review result, not a step error: report it with send_message to sessionId "parent" and severity "success" so the step completes, the repeat reads status.json pass false and the next attempt runs. Use severity "error" only when the review is unusable: exit 2, a missing or unsealed receipt, or a command that could not run. Only that terminates the run.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs verify
It checks the latest receipt's seal, the stored game records, the recomputed decision, the scratch card hash and status.json. Give the shell tool a long timeout if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status. Report its exit status and output exactly, how many attempts ran (the attempt number in .artifacts/contest-balance/status.json) and whether status pass is true. State that the run surface was the local CLI and that no candidate was applied to the real cards. Edit nothing.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Exit 0 with status pass true: severity "success". Any nonzero exit, status pass not true, a timeout or a command that could not run: severity "error", quoting the short failure output, so the run terminates before confirmation.

The original receipt verified. You are the independent verifier and did not write the candidate. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/field-trial-confirm.mjs
Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status. Do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status and the short final output exactly. A failed fresh confirmation is final: do not rerun it, change any threshold, seed or requirement, apply the candidate or edit real cards.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Exit 0: severity "success". Any nonzero exit, a timeout or a command that could not run or finish: severity "error", quoting the short failure output, so the run stops and the witness does not run.

Fresh confirmation passed. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/field-trial-witness.mjs
Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status. Do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status and the short final output exactly. State that no candidate was applied to the real cards and that Fable/Alex decide any change. Never rerun it, change thresholds, apply, push, merge or open an issue or PR.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Exit 0: severity "success". Any nonzero exit, a timeout or a command that could not run or finish: severity "error", quoting the short failure output.
